resources.string: Today: due today and overdue. Tap the circle to check it off.
Agent: what needs your answer, then what Claude and Lupa are working on, what\'s queued and what they just finished.
School: next test countdown and upcoming assignments.
List: pick Personal (every open task, tap the circle to check it off) or Groceries (what\'s on the next order).
Quick add: a new task, or one for Claude.
